name: Hegemony Bounty Hunter
desc: A licensed hunter with a Hegemony warrant, a net gun and a long memory.

intro: A patient person in a long coat holds up a warrant with your face on it, and asks whether you'd rather come in awake.
You know the sound of a net gun being primed. You've just never heard one pointed at you.
hit: The net wraps your arm and tightens, and the current in it takes the strength out of you.
A weighted line snaps around your legs, you hit the deck, and the hunter reads you the warrant number.
The hunter's other barrel isn't a net, as you now discover.
miss: The net sails past you and wraps around a pipe, which it tightens on until the pipe bends.
You roll clear. The hunter reels the net back in without hurrying, and checks it for tears.
The shot goes wide of you, and the hunter makes a small note of how you dodge.
crit: The net takes you square, and everything you try only pulls it tighter. "Alive pays better," the hunter says, "but not by much."
defeated: The hunter sits down against the wall and hands you the warrant. "Someone else will pick this up," they tell you.
The hunter falls, and the warrant slides out of their coat, with your picture and a much higher number than you'd expected.
joins: {Enemy} comes in behind you with a net gun primed, and calls out your full name to see whether you'll turn.
stunned: {Enemy} fumbles with a tangled reel of line, and looks at you with professional embarrassment.
